main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of 7-bar forward return minus coin mean on forecast, non-overlapping samples
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with timing check), t <= -2 rejects, at least 300 independent cases

supporting_check.name: book mean daily timing gain before costs

decided_by: The slope's t is between -2 and 2, which neither confirms nor rejects.
reading: The coin's mean 7-bar return is the mean of its non-overlapping 7-bar samples over all windows, the regression has an intercept, and the per-coin book before costs earns the held allocation x the coin's daily return, averaged over coins each day, with the market part being the allocation x the coin's mean daily return over all windows.
